SKILL.md:977 calls a sha256 a revision. `git -C LANE show 9f1d3c339a7094968041c7708a65dbf7eab9fae6:tools/mutate-and-run.sh | sha256sum` -> cf41efaa8be5f52d92bf7806ddb3a99a031547bf12a6811b8ef45bce37242c75 (1341 L / 61632 B), i.e. the tool's content hash; `git -C LANE rev-parse --verify --quiet 'cf41efaa^{commit}'` fails, so a reader who takes 'revision' literally cannot resolve it from git. The round-51 reader recorded exactly this (T51W2Read07.md:142 'cf41efaa… is a content sha, not a revision … the section's word revision is loose'). The measurement itself is unchanged by the relabel.
